context:
2026-11-12: owner decision: do not start this until PR 4154 (fix/correctness-gates, another session) merges; it rewrites the same row-count validation files (benchbox/core/validation/query_validation.py, benchbox/core/dataframe/query_validation.py, benchbox/core/results/query_execution.py). Re-diagnose on develop after it lands. Lead for the diagnosis: validate_query_result returns is_valid=True with expected_row_count kept when the mode is SKIP (query_validation.py, the 'marked as skip in expected results' branch), which export then sees as PASSED with unequal counts.

2026-11-15: re-diagnosed on develop 21b0b2beb7. Cause: Q16 at SF 1 with --seed 42 returns 18150 rows against a reference of 18314; loose validation accepted it and the record was written as PASSED with unequal counts, which export rejects. PR 4154 (merged 2026-11-12) records a within-tolerance, non-equal count as SKIPPED with a warning (benchbox/platforms/base/result_capture.py, benchbox/core/dataframe/query_validation.py); tests/unit/platforms/test_adapter_validation_consistency.py covers it. Verified: `benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --scale 1 --seed 42 --phases generate,load,power --compression zstd:9 --non-interactive` wrote a bundle with summary.validation passed (68 PASSED, 20 SKIPPED rows; Q16 SKIPPED 18314 vs 18150). The same command with --official is now refused before running by full-spec enforcement (PR 4137), so the seed-corpus cell criterion moved to seed-corpus-official-cells-refused-by-full-spec-20261115 by owner decision.
description: Found 2026-11-11 on develop c7b75c80bc (macOS arm64, DuckDB 1.5.5). `benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --scale 1 --official --seed 42 --phases generate,load,power --compression zstd:9 --non-interactive` runs the workload, then export raises `ResultExportError: Failed to export json: PASSED row_count_validation requires equal integer expected and actual counts` (benchbox/core/results/query_execution.py:380) and no bundle is written. It fails the same way with and without `--capture-plans`, so plan capture is not the cause. Some measured row carries row_count_validation status PASSED with expected != actual, which the export contract rejects. This is the exact command of the seed-corpus matrix cell for TPC-H SF 1 (`official: true`); the last scheduled seed-corpus run succeeded on 2026-11-01, so either the regression is newer or it is host-specific. The same run at SF 0.1 without a seed exports cleanly. Not yet known: which query, and whether Linux CI reproduces.
